# Copilot Instructions for Coraza WAF

The guidance for this repository lives in a single file at the repository root:

**[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)**

Read it before making changes. It covers code style, project-specific
conventions, performance and security guidelines, and — most importantly — the
**Testing** section, which defines where each kind of test belongs and the rules
that keep the suite from accumulating duplicated coverage.

Do not add guidance to this file. Edit `AGENTS.md` instead, so every agent and
every contributor reads the same rules.
